records.title: NEED OF A RAILWAY OVER BRIDGE NEAR MANOHARPUR RAILWAY STATION
details:
a to c: There is a Level Crossing (LC) No. 193A at Km. 373/21-23 at Manoharpur Railway station yard of Chakradharpur Railway Division.
The work of preparation of Technical Feasibility Report/ Detailed Project Report (TFR/DPR) for the construction of ROB/RUB in lieu of LC No. 193A has been taken up.

records.title: Forest Clearance to Iron Ore Mine
details: Part (a) to (c) : The proposal for diversion of 247.50 hectares of forest land from already leased 1936.06 ha of Kiriburu- Meghahatuburu group of iron-ore mines in favour of the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) in West Singhbhum district of Jharkhand was granted ‘in-principle’ approval vide this Ministry’s letter dated 18.10.2010 read with letter dated 07.05.2014 subject to fulfilment of certain conditions prescribed therein. In this regard, the complete information as sought by the Ministry has not been submitted by the State Government so far.
